acceptance: The three bypass paths call translate_sql_query; their duplicated fix-ups are removed.
ClickBench translation failure raises or logs a typed error instead of returning the original query silently, with a test.

A new AST-scanning test fails when a module outside the wrapper and sql_compat calls transpile, parse_one or .sql on the vendored module; remaining known offenders are listed in an explicit, shrinking allowlist owned by sqlglot-fork-b2-migrate-direct-importers.
make pr-preflight, make comment-policy-check, make typecheck and tests/unit/sql_compat/test_translate_sql_delegation.py pass.
description: platforms/base/dialect_translation.py duplicates the DuckDB ALL restore and SQLite fix-up on its own transpile call; base.py translate_query and core/clickbench/benchmark.py also call the fork directly, and ClickBench silently swallows every exception. Route them through the existing wrapper, replace the silent fallback with a logged typed error, and add a repository test that fails on direct vendored-SQLGlot calls outside the wrapper and benchbox/sql_compat/. Existing fork behavior only; no fork change needed.
